summary.prose: Correct candidate identity so manifest metadata changes invalidate prior assessments. Preserve the pure corpus contracts, define missing/duplicate coverage behavior, and prove the digest chain with independent vectors and stale-assessment regressions before fresh daemon code review.

tasks.title: Define sc1/sc2 runtime schemas and types
tasks.summary: Add proposed src/design/corpus/contracts.ts with closed TypeBox schemas and Static-derived types matching approved sc1/sc2; pin all ten domain labels, UI types, IDs, digest formats, optional field semantics, draft/publication distinctions and ValidationIssue categories. Add shared independently authored test fixtures under __tests__/fixtures.ts.
acceptanceChecks: All approved sc1/sc2 fields are represented once in runtime/static schemas; no unknown-property stripping, coercion or default injection.
Known valid foundation/pattern/style-recipe records decode without losing fields; invalid schema versions and structural omissions return stable issues.
Existing TypeBox/AJV dependencies suffice; no package manifest change.

tests.name: contracts.test.ts — closed schema, version, ID/domain/UI enums and original fixture acceptance

tasks.title: Implement canonical bytes and digest chain
tasks.summary: Update canonical.ts to hash the complete validated manifest snapshot except the three cyclic digest slots; preserve canonical JSON, record identity and raw byte rules. Stage coverage path/mediaType before hashing, independently regenerate candidate/review/release vectors and update digest documentation.
acceptanceChecks: Key order and manifest inventory order do not affect identity; meaningful record-array order does.

recordVersion excludes recordVersion/review; candidate excludes only releaseId, reviewDigest and the unique coverage file digest. All other fields, including coverage path/mediaType, bind assessments; records/files sort by ID/version and path. Release hashes manifest without releaseId.
Invalid Unicode, non-JSON values, accessors, cycles, oversized input and non-finite/unsafe numbers are rejected before unbounded traversal or content hashing.
Zero/multiple coverage matches yield empty candidate identity; never omit all matches or choose arbitrarily. Tests cover every non-cyclic metadata field and all three exclusions.

tests.name: canonical.test.ts — independent byte/digest vectors and invalid JSON/limit boundaries

tasks.title: Validate guidance completeness and review binding
tasks.summary: Add record validation in validate.ts using schema-first checks followed by domain, provenance, UI-type specimen and review invariants. Preserve authored values and return deterministic JSON Pointer issues; do not evaluate license policy or generate guidance.
acceptanceChecks: Missing provenance, applicability, required examples, domain payloads, measurable-check limits or explicit no-check rationale prevents admission.
Each declared UI type has example and misuse references; Color/Layout/Visual style conditional payloads are enforced together when applicable.
Draft/stale/incomplete review cannot pass publication checks; inferred authorship stays inferred.
All identity, version, relations, rationale and lineage fields survive validated JSON round-trip.

tests.name: record-validation.test.ts — completeness, authorship, conditional payloads and platform examples
record-roundtrip.test.ts — all sc1 fields preserved and review-staleness rejection

tasks.title: Validate release inventory and exact references
tasks.summary: Extend validate.ts with pure in-memory manifest/inventory validation: closed membership, regular files, portable paths, raw-byte digests, unique record identities and exact acyclic relations. Verify the digest sequence and referenced source/notices/coverage files without implementing source or editorial policies.
acceptanceChecks: Reject missing/undeclared/duplicate/case-colliding entries, unsafe paths and nonregular files.
Manifest record pairs match decoded bytes; relations resolve exactly, with duplicate/self/cyclic references rejected.
Verify file, record, candidate, review and release digests; no manifest self hash or final releaseId in coverage.
Format limits return explicit issues instead of silently truncating records or inventory.
Coverage is inspected only as canonical JSON for digest/candidate binding; no licensing allowlist or editorial coverage algorithm is implemented.
Malformed coverage membership remains ineligible: zero matches preserves reference.missing, duplicates inventory.invalid, and no computable candidate is invented.

tests.name: manifest-validation.test.ts — in-memory exact inventory, portable paths, relations DAG and tamper cases

tasks.title: Compose publication preflight and expose the pure module
tasks.summary: Add digest-bound eligibility/coverage assessment composition and public barrel index.ts. Require both downstream stages without importing their future implementations. Export foundational schemas/types and pure validation/hash helpers, documenting distinctions between draft validation, preflight eligibility and actual publication.
acceptanceChecks: Missing, duplicate, failed, stale or contradictory assessments yield eligible=false with stable issues; matching successful fixtures yield eligible=true.
PublicationCheck.manifestDigest is canonical manifest hash when computable, otherwise empty; errors do not fabricate hashes.
Imports and calls perform no file/DB/network/provider access or catalog writes; no runtime approval claims are made.
Only sc1/sc2 foundational surfaces are exported; no ingestion, retrieval, settings or publication mutations are added.

Changing source/notices roles without changing bytes and resealing releaseId rejects old coverage and both assessments. Missing/duplicate coverage entries mark every supplied assessment stale while preserving independently computable manifestDigest.

tests.name: publication-check.test.ts — downstream assessment composition fails closed and preserves issue diagnostics

tasks.title: Verify contract coverage and strict build integration
tasks.summary: Run current-source isolated import and preflight, corpus regressions, strict build and affected insrc gates. Independently recompute development goldens, retaining the record golden, and obtain fresh daemon code review before S001 completion.
acceptanceChecks: ac1 and ac2 each have passing proving tests; expected digest bytes/values are independent of the helper under test.
Focused unit/contract tests and npm run build pass, or unrelated pre-existing failures are isolated and reported accurately.
Compiled import has no live-store/provider requirements; no test touches live ~/.insrc data.
Diff remains within S001 modules/tests and tracked artifacts; no completion is claimed before build validation and independent code review.
An isolated process exercises valid and invalid preflight with external I/O instrumented or forbidden; asserts no filesystem writes, network/provider calls or live-store creation.
Rerun t2/t4/t5/t6 gates against corrected source; include t1/t3 tests in focused suite. Fresh daemon review covers final corpus commit range, with no dirty-ledger scope substitution.

tests.name: module-isolation.test.ts — compiled import and valid/invalid preflight without external I/O
npm run build — strict NodeNext compilation

testStrategyCoverage.lldStrategyItem: record-schema: missing/unknown/wrong-type fields and each authorship branch
domain-validation: color roles/pairings, layout adaptation, visual style and platform example/misuse matrix
review-binding: draft exclusion and stale-content rejection
issue-format: stable codes/pointers, deterministic order, no raw content
canonical-golden: key reorder, numeric/string edge cases, manifest sort and meaningful array order
digest-chain: record→candidate→review→release no self reference, changed-content invalidation
invalid-input: accessors, cyclic objects, unicode/numeric/size limits
candidate-metadata-binding: role paths, attribution, timestamp, schema and all record/file metadata affect candidate identity; only three cyclic digest positions are excluded
manifest-inventory: exact bytes/path/membership, digest tamper, duplicate/case collision, missing target and relation-cycle rejection
publication-composition: missing/duplicate/failed/stale assessments always block; valid fixed assessments pass
stale-role-assessment: swap sourceManifestPath/noticesPath with unchanged bytes, reseal only releaseId, and prove preflight rejects the old envelope and assessments

noncomputable-candidate: zero and duplicate coverage entries produce empty candidate identity, ineligible preflight and assessment.stale for every supplied assessment; independently recomputed manifestDigest remains available
Import compiled corpus barrel in a fresh process with no daemon/DB/provider setup
